description: This Kotlin source file defines the HomeFragment class for an Android TV application using the Leanback library, responsible for building the home screen UI with multiple horizontally scrollable rows of media cards, each with custom focus behaviors and image handling. It includes data models, presenters, and UI construction logic.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: A fragment that displays a home screen with multiple horizontal media rows such as 'Seguí viendo' and 'Canales de TV', using Leanback's BrowseSupportFragment.

classes.name: CardItem
classes.description: Data model for media or channel cards, including title, image resource, and optional progress indicator.

classes.name: CardPresenterSelector
classes.description: A PresenterSelector that provides a custom presenter for card items.

classes.name: OPImageCardPresenter
classes.description: Custom presenter for image cards with enhanced styling, focus animation, and progress bar overlay.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI setup when the activity is created.

methods.name: buildUI
methods.description: Constructs the UI by setting header styles, creating rows for 'Seguí viendo' and 'Canales de TV', and setting click/selection listeners.

methods.name: buildListRow
methods.description: Creates a ListRow with a header and a list of CardItems.

methods.name: buildContinueWatchingItems
methods.description: Generates a list of CardItems representing 'Continue Watching' movies.

methods.name: buildTvChannelItems
methods.description: Generates a list of CardItems representing TV channels.
